hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A traffic light repeats its sequence every g + y + r seconds.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Take the timestamp modulo the complete cycle duration: rem = t % (g + y + r).

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Map the remainder to Green if rem < g, Yellow if rem < g + y, and Red otherwise.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct modulo arithmetic computes the phase in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating second by second leads to TLE for large t.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies modular arithmetic over periodic state cycles.
